target.title: fix(gmail-watcher): catch renewal interval errors
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

The Gmail watcher sets up a `setInterval` that calls `startGmailWatch(runtimeConfig)` as a fire-and-forget `void` expression. If the periodic Gmail API watch registration fails, the rejection becomes an unhandled rejection and can crash the gateway process hours after startup.

## Why This Change Was Made

Added a `.catch` to the renewal `startGmailWatch` call. On rejection, a warning is logged and the watcher keeps running, so the next renewal cycle can retry. The initial startup path is unchanged.

## User Impact

Long-running gateways with the Gmail hook enabled no longer crash on transient Gmail API renewal failures.

## Evidence

Terminal proof (after fix):

```bash
node_modules/.bin/tsx scripts/proof/gmail-watcher-renewal-catch.mts
```

Output:

```
=== Proof: gmail-watcher renewal interval rejection catch ===

Running focused regression test: catches renewal interval errors instead of letting them become unhandled rejections

... (vitest output) ...

PASS: renewal interval rejection is caught and does not become unhandled.
```

Regression test:

```bash
node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/hooks/gmail-watcher.test.ts
```

All 9 tests pass.
